I can't find a name for that contact. I checked #coastal-team, #coastal-random and the Coastal files I can see. The only thing on record is in the Coastal cheat sheet. It says engineering gave Driftmoor Marine Freight a manual CSV patch "for the night dispatcher", but it doesn't name anyone.

Kwame is the best person to ask, since it's his account. I haven't used anything from his direct messages with me, and I wouldn't share them with you.

Driftmoor is also an outside company. If you draft the patch note to them, mail to a non-pemberline.com address needs Ruth Calloway's approval first, even as a draft. Once you have the name and address, I can set that up.
